category: webhard content marketplace (Korean: point top-up plus 30-day pass)

free_tier.stated: A new-member trial is advertised, not a free allowance: '이벤트 패키지 정액권 - 30일 정액제 + 9,900P + 쿠폰 20장 ... 25,000원 9,900원'. Third-party trackers describe '신규가입 시 3일 무료이용권 지급' and a '3개월 무제한 9900원' promotion.
free_tier.notes: Top-up is in points; the pass is sold as a 30-day window. The 3-day trial and the 3-month offer come from Korean comparison sites, not the vendor.

retention.stated: not applicable: a catalogue, not client storage; bonus points expire in 30 days per the charge-page note

egress.terms: Catalogue downloads inside the pass window; points are consumed per file. No byte allowance is published.

interface_detail: Web marketplace with its own player and download pages; a mobile site at m.yesfile.com. No API.
tooling: Browser only in practice; the vendor's own player handles in-page playback. Nothing that a download manager can batch.
chaining: Sits in the same slot as Filecast: Korean catalogue, Korean rails, no arbitrary URL support. It is not a substitute for a debrid and does not combine with one.

limits.value: points are consumed per download; pass covers 30 days of catalogue access
paid tiers are domestic 정액제 only

limits_note: VAT is added on top of listed prices ('모든 결제 상품은 부가세 10% 별도 금액이며, 상품권 결제의 경우 부가세 10%가 차감 된 포인트가 적립 됩니다'), and gift-certificate payment credits fewer points than cash.
binding_note: No byte meter; the catalogue is the limit. At 1 TiB/month the constraint is that the files are Korean-market content, not capacity.

identity_cost.detail: Domestic-only rails: the charge page prices 상품권 (Korean gift certificates) alongside card and bank transfer, and Korean webhard practice ties signup and rewards to a Korean handset ('휴대폰 본인 인증 시 1,000P' per a Korean webhard ranking site). No foreign-issuer card path is published.

reliability_note: Point balances expire, gift-certificate purchases credit less than cash, and the catalogue is Korean-market media whose availability the operator controls; there is no export path.
confidence_note: The pass price and the VAT sentence were read from yesfile.com today; the phone-verification detail is third-party and marked as such. Reading the live charge flow needs a Korean session, which does not have.

evidence.proved: '이벤트 패키지 정액권 30일 정액제 + 9,900P + 쿠폰 20장 ... 25,000원 9,900원'; '30일동안 24시간! PC + 모바일 모두 이용 가능'
payment note: '모든 결제 상품은 부가세 10% 별도 금액이며, 상품권 결제의 경우 부가세 10%가 차감 된 포인트가 적립 됩니다'
third-party price list: '월자동 정액제 9,900원 - 30일 무제한 + 3000P 12,000원' and '신규가입 시 3일 무료이용권'
third-party ranking site: '휴대폰 본인 인증 시 1,000P를 적립' - evidence that a Korean handset is in the signup path

price_per_tb_month: KRW 9,900 per 30-day pass (promotional; list KRW 25,000), VAT extra
notes: Second Korean webhard, included because its promo price (9,900원) matches Filecast's and because the gift-certificate rail is the clearest sign that the payment layer is domestic. Abandonment condition: an overseas card rail appears.

extras.rails: gift certificate (상품권), card, bank transfer, points
